text: Eleven-year-old Coraline Jones [moves with her busy parents into the Pink Palace Apartments|trigger|making a new home], an old Victorian house in Oregon, and finds a small door in the living room with only bricks behind it. At night it opens onto a tunnel to the Other World, where [button-eyed doubles of her parents|threat|impostors and doubles] lavish her with food and attention. The Other Mother offers to keep her there forever [if she lets buttons be sewn onto her eyes|rules|everything has a price], and three ghost children tell her whose lives [the Beldam has already swallowed|wants|claiming souls and victims].
